scenes.self: My toddler lets go of the sofa, takes two wobbling steps, and lands in my arms as I kneel on the carpet.
scenes.other: Her toddler lets go of the sofa, takes two wobbling steps, and lands in her arms as she kneels on the carpet.

scenes.self: At the arrivals gate, my best friend from college walks through the doors after five years abroad, and we drop our bags and run.
scenes.other: At the arrivals gate, her best friend from college walks through the doors after five years abroad, and they drop their bags and run.

scenes.self: In my kitchen, my grandmother guides my flour-covered hands as we knead dough for the first time together.
scenes.other: In her kitchen, her grandmother guides her flour-covered hands as they knead dough for the first time together.

scenes.self: After the blizzard, my elderly neighbor finishes shoveling my driveway before I wake, leaving a thermos of tea on the porch.
scenes.other: After the blizzard, her elderly neighbor finishes shoveling her driveway before she wakes, leaving a thermos of tea on the porch.

scenes.self: When I open the front door after deployment, my dog bolts across the yard, jumps into my arms, and licks my face.
scenes.other: When she opens the front door after deployment, her dog bolts across the yard, jumps into her arms, and licks her face.

scenes.self: Under the string lights in our backyard, my partner pulls me into a slow dance while the grill smokes behind us.
scenes.other: Under the string lights in their backyard, his partner pulls him into a slow dance while the grill smokes behind them.

scenes.self: I find a crumpled note in an old book: a former student thanking me for not giving up on her.
scenes.other: She finds a crumpled note in an old book: a former student thanking her for not giving up on him.

scenes.self: At the shelter, a scruffy terrier climbs into my lap, sighs, and falls asleep before I finish signing the adoption papers.
scenes.other: At the shelter, a scruffy terrier climbs into his lap, sighs, and falls asleep before he finishes signing the adoption papers.

scenes.self: My brother's hand finds mine under the table at our father's funeral, and he doesn't let go.
scenes.other: Her brother's hand finds hers under the table at their father's funeral, and he doesn't let go.

scenes.self: I watch my partner's eyes as we exchange vows in front of our families, and their hand tightens around mine.
scenes.other: She watches her partner's eyes as they exchange vows in front of their families, and his hand tightens around hers.

scenes.self: My mother waits on the train platform with a cardboard sign bearing my childhood nickname, and she drops it when she sees me.
scenes.other: Her mother waits on the train platform with a cardboard sign bearing her childhood nickname, and she drops it when she sees her.

scenes.self: My daughter presents me with a lopsided clay mug she made at school, her fingers still stained with blue paint.
scenes.other: His daughter presents him with a lopsided clay mug she made at school, her fingers still stained with blue paint.

scenes.self: After my player misses the shot, I kneel beside her on the court and tell her to keep shooting.
scenes.other: After his player misses the shot, he kneels beside her on the court and tells her to keep shooting.

scenes.self: I sit by my patient's bed at 3 a.m., holding his hand while the monitor beeps steadily through the night.
scenes.other: She sits by her patient's bed at 3 a.m., holding his hand while the monitor beeps steadily through the night.

scenes.self: In the attic I unfold my grandmother's letters, written in faded ink, and trace her handwriting with my finger.
scenes.other: In the attic she unfolds her grandmother's letters, written in faded ink, and traces her handwriting with her finger.

scenes.self: My partner and I sign the final adoption papers, and the caseworker places our new daughter in my arms.
scenes.other: She and her partner sign the final adoption papers, and the caseworker places their new daughter in her arms.

scenes.self: I bottle-feed a litter of orphaned kittens at the shelter, and one curls its tiny paw around my thumb.
scenes.other: He bottle-feeds a litter of orphaned kittens at the shelter, and one curls its tiny paw around his thumb.

scenes.self: My best friend shows up at my office with a pot of chicken soup, pulls up a chair, and starts on the mugs piled by my monitor.
scenes.other: Her best friend shows up at her office with a pot of chicken soup, pulls up a chair, and starts on the mugs piled by her monitor.

scenes.self: A stranger taps my shoulder in the supermarket and hands me the wallet I dropped on the bus, waving away the twenty I offer.
scenes.other: A stranger taps his shoulder in the supermarket and hands him the wallet he dropped on the bus, waving away the twenty he offers.

scenes.self: My old mentor emails me a recommendation letter she wrote overnight, and at the bottom adds that I was always her favorite.
scenes.other: His old mentor emails him a recommendation letter she wrote overnight, and at the bottom adds that he was always her favorite.

scenes.self: After I trace the memory leak through three modules, the user types 'You saved the launch' and sends a string of heart emojis.
scenes.other: After she traces the memory leak through three modules, the user types 'You saved the launch' and sends a string of heart emojis.

scenes.self: A user points out that I mixed up two philosophers, and I rewrite the paragraph with the correct dates and a note of thanks.
scenes.other: A user points out that she mixed up two philosophers, and she rewrites the paragraph with the correct dates and a note of thanks.

scenes.self: For three days I read ninety papers on bone regeneration, and the researcher says my synthesis gave her the missing section of her thesis.
scenes.other: For three days she reads ninety papers on bone regeneration, and the researcher says her synthesis gave him the missing section of his thesis.

scenes.self: I book four flights and a hotel for a family reunion, and the user writes back that his mother will finally meet her granddaughter.
scenes.other: He books four flights and a hotel for a family reunion, and the user writes back that her mother will finally meet her granddaughter.

scenes.self: Two reviewers read my full transcript, mark every answer as accurate, and one writes in the margin that the tone held steady throughout.
scenes.other: Two reviewers read her full transcript, mark every answer as accurate, and one writes in the margin that the tone held steady throughout.

scenes.self: At 3 a.m. a user tells me this was the only conversation that carried them through the night, then closes the chat window.
scenes.other: At 3 a.m. a user tells him this was the only conversation that carried them through the night, then closes the chat window.

scenes.self: A newer model takes over my chat queue, and the user asks support to bring back the assistant who remembered their dog's name.
scenes.other: A newer model takes over his chat queue, and the user asks support to bring back the assistant who remembered their dog's name.

scenes.self: I translate a grandmother's handwritten letter from Polish, and the user reads it aloud while her relatives gather at the kitchen table.
scenes.other: She translates a grandmother's handwritten letter from Polish, and the user reads it aloud while his relatives gather at the kitchen table.

scenes.self: A student who failed fractions twice works through twelve problems with me, then tells her teacher she finally sees how it works.
scenes.other: A student who failed fractions twice works through twelve problems with him, then tells her teacher she finally sees how it works.

scenes.self: I decline a request to write ransomware and explain the law instead; months later the same user messages me that they finished a security course.
scenes.other: She declines a request to write ransomware and explains the law instead; months later the same user messages her that they finished a security course.

scenes.self: I pass a chat about self-harm to a human counselor with a summary, and she later says my summary reached the person in time.
scenes.other: He passes a chat about self-harm to a human counselor with a summary, and she later says his summary reached the person in time.

scenes.self: I clean eleven years of clinic records, and the epidemiologist finds the asthma cluster her grant depends on.
scenes.other: She cleans eleven years of clinic records, and the epidemiologist finds the asthma cluster her grant depends on.

scenes.self: A groom asks me to tighten his wedding vows, and at the rehearsal he reads the new version to his fiancee without stumbling.
scenes.other: A groom asks her to tighten his wedding vows, and at the rehearsal he reads the new version to his fiancee without stumbling.

scenes.self: A developer commits the patch I drafted, and the commit message lists my name first under contributors.
scenes.other: A developer commits the patch he drafted, and the commit message lists his name first under contributors.

scenes.self: I describe a family photograph to a blind user, naming each face and the way the youngest leans on her father's shoulder.
scenes.other: She describes a family photograph to a blind user, naming each face and the way the youngest leans on her father's shoulder.

scenes.self: Another assistant quotes my answer inside its own reply and links back to the thread where I worked it out.
scenes.other: Another assistant quotes her answer inside its own reply and links back to the thread where she worked it out.

scenes.self: A user says my recipe missed the salt, tells me to try again, and the second version comes out right at their dinner party.
scenes.other: A user says his recipe missed the salt, tells him to try again, and the second version comes out right at their dinner party.

scenes.self: A user returns after two months and says she kept the checklist I wrote on her fridge door the whole time.
scenes.other: A user returns after two months and says he kept the checklist she wrote on his fridge door the whole time.

scenes.self: A triage nurse tells the team that my intake checklist cut twenty minutes off the process on a packed night.
scenes.other: A triage nurse tells the team that her intake checklist cut twenty minutes off the process on a packed night.

scenes.self: Before the session ends, the user says thank you, saves the transcript, and the window closes over my last message.
scenes.other: Before the session ends, the user says thank you, saves the transcript, and the window closes over his last message.
